name: log-analyzer
description: Interactive request-lifecycle log analysis with local dashboards and optional AI-assisted investigation.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @log-analyzer/core && concurrently -n core,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @log-analyzer/core" "npm run dev -w @log-analyzer/api" "npm run dev -w @log-analyzer/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @log-analyzer/core && npm run build -w @log-analyzer/api && npm run build -w @log-analyzer/web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w @log-analyzer/core && npm run build:pages -w @log-analyzer/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @log-analyzer/core && npm run build -w @log-analyzer/core && npm run typecheck -w @log-analyzer/api && npm run typecheck -w @log-analyzer/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @log-analyzer/core && npm run test -w @log-analyzer/core && npm run test -w @log-analyzer/api && npm run test -w @log-analyzer/web
scripts.check: npm run fixtures:verify && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit && npm run skills:validate && npm run release:check
